title: Groundnut — Varieties, Seed Rate and Sowing
content:
RECOMMENDED VARIETIES FOR KARNATAKA:
Kharif: GPBD-4 (bunch, 95-100 days, 2.5 t/ha), TMV-2 (bunch, 100-110 days), Girnar-2 (bunch), Kadiri-6 (runner).
Rabi/Summer: GPBD-4, JL-24 (bunch, 100 days), TAG-24.

SEED RATE:
Bunch varieties: 100-125 kg/ha. Runner varieties: 80-100 kg/ha. Ensure minimum germination 80-85%.

SEED TREATMENT (Mandatory):
1. Carbendazim @ 2g/kg seed (fungicide treatment).
2. Rhizobium japonicum culture @ 600g/ha.
3. PSB (Phosphate Solubilizing Bacteria) @ 600g/ha.
4. Apply biofertilizers after fungicide drying.

SPACING:
Irrigated: 30 x 10 cm (row x plant). Rainfed: 45 x 10 cm.
Mechanical sowing: 45 x 10 cm.

SOWING DEPTH: 4-5 cm in red sandy loam soil. 3-4 cm in black soils.

SEASON:
Kharif: June-July (with onset of southwest monsoon).
Rabi: October-November.
Summer (irrigated only): February-March.

LAND PREPARATION:
Deep plowing 30cm before kharif sowing. 2-3 harrowings. Form ridges and furrows in rainfed areas for moisture conservation.
